component.name: NetStats-Live
component.summary: Compact live network throughput and CPU monitor

description.p: NetStats-Live is a compact Qt 6 desktop monitor for Linux. It displays incoming and outgoing traffic, transfer totals, remote reachability, thread count, and CPU activity in an always-available vertical panel.
It supports generic Linux desktop builds and optional KDE Plasma integration for layer-shell placement, native window activation, tray access, and Klipper clipboard capture.

screenshot.caption: NetStats-Live monitoring local and remote network activity
